newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns says earnings flat in latest quarter.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns says earnings flat in latest quarter.

text.p: Bear Stearns Cos. Inc. on Tuesday reported flat earnings for the latest quarter as higher income from commissions and trading activities was offset by a drop in investment banking revenues.

But the nation's sixth largest brokerage said earnings for the fiscal year ended June 30 rose 25 percent to a record, reflecting the strength in the financial markets that has helped other brokerages report solid results this year.
Bear Stearns said net income edged up to $162.9 million, or $1.15 a share, in its fourth quarter from $162.8 million, or $1.13 a share, a year earlier.

The results exceeded forecasts on Wall Street, but Bear Stearns stock fell 31 cents to $38.50 in consolidated afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange. Analysts had estimated earnings of 95 cents a share on average, according to First Call, which tracks forecasts.
Sales net of interest expense rose 9 percent to $962.6 million from $885.3 million.
Revenue from stock and other commissions and Bear Stearns' trading for its owns account rose, the New York-based brokerage said.
But investment banking revenue, while reflecting strong merger and acquisition activity in the quarter, fell 19 percent from a record levels a year earlier, the company said.
For the year, Bear Stearns said net income rose to $613.3 million, or $4.20 a share, from $490.6 million, or $3.27 a share. Sales rose to $3.53 billion from $2.98 billion.
